description: This file defines an abstract class 'Coordinate' with static methods for manipulating Excel-like cell coordinates, ranges, and references within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Coordinate
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for handling cell coordinate conversions, range parsing, and reference extraction in spreadsheet processing.

methods.name: coordinateFromString
methods.description: Converts a cell address string like 'A1' into column and row components.

methods.name: indexesFromString
methods.description: Returns numeric column index, row number, and column string from a cell coordinate string.

methods.name: coordinateIsRange
methods.description: Checks if a cell address string represents a range of cells.

methods.name: absoluteReference
methods.description: Converts a cell reference to an absolute reference with '$' signs, optionally including worksheet name.

methods.name: absoluteCoordinate
methods.description: Converts a cell coordinate to an absolute coordinate string with '$' signs.

methods.name: splitRange
methods.description: Splits a range string into individual coordinate pairs.

methods.name: buildRange
methods.description: Builds a range string from an array of coordinate pairs.

methods.name: rangeBoundaries
methods.description: Calculates the start and end cell coordinates of a range.

methods.name: rangeDimension
methods.description: Returns the width and height of a range.

methods.name: getRangeBoundaries
methods.description: Returns the start and end cell references of a range as strings.

methods.name: columnIndexFromString
methods.description: Converts a column letter string to a numeric index (A=1).

methods.name: stringFromColumnIndex
methods.description: Converts a column index to its letter string representation.

methods.name: extractAllCellReferencesInRange
methods.description: Extracts all individual cell references within a range, including multiple ranges.

methods.name: mergeRangesInCollection
methods.description: Merges adjacent cells with identical values into ranges.

methods.name: getCellBlocksFromRangeString
methods.description: Splits a range string into individual cell blocks and operators.

methods.name: validateRange
methods.description: Validates that a range's start and end coordinates are logically correct.
